_comment: The Archive Groves — petals from leaves, and Alfheim's own trees.
tools/gen_groves.py turns this into loot tables, blocks, textures and worldgen.
Design record: alfheim_reclaimed_design/ORE_SUPPLEMENTATION.md §9
TWO JOBS, one file:
1. leaf_petals — every tree that grows in Alfheim drops petals of its own colour.
This is the renewable answer to B-46 (there were no petals in Alfheim at all).
The generator COPIES the mod's existing loot pools verbatim out of its jar and
appends one petal pool, so sapling and stick drops cannot be silently lost —
archwood saplings in particular are a Rite I reagent. Re-running after a mod
update re-reads the jar, so the override self-heals rather than drifting.
2. trees — three trees of our own that carry other forests' seeds. Their leaves drop
randomized VANILLA saplings, which is how Alfheim gets oak, birch, spruce and the
rest: no vanilla tree generates here, so without this there is no apple, no oak
plank, and no tree variety of any kind.
They are replantable as of 2026-09-03. KubeJS 2001.6.5 has no SaplingBlock builder
and no TreeGrower binding, so growth is done in the sapling's randomTick callback,
placing trunk and canopy through BlockContainerJS.offset(Direction, int) -- the one
overload confirmed present in the jar. Leaves drop their own sapling at 0.03, rarer
than the foreign vanilla seeds at 0.055. Closed B-49.
Between them the two lists cover all 16 petal colours.
'chance' is the base drop rate before Fortune, applied on the vanilla apple-pool
pattern: not on shears, not on silk touch, survives explosion, scales with Fortune.

leaf_petals.note: Pale and silver. Grows in almost every Alfheim biome, so this is the workhorse.
